mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_trace_event (session_id, trace_id, seq, event_type, occurred_at_ms, turn_no, step_no, call_id, parent_event_id, status, duration_ms, tool_name, error_code, payload_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{traceId}, #{seq}, #{eventType}, #{occurredAtMs}, #{turnNo}, #{stepNo}, #{callId}, #{parentEventId}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{toolName}, #{errorCode}, #{payloadJson})
mapper.sql: id, session_id AS sessionId, trace_id AS traceId, seq, event_type AS eventType, occurred_at_ms AS occurredAtMs, persisted_at AS persistedAt, turn_no AS turnNo, step_no AS stepNo, call_id AS callId, parent_event_id AS parentEventId, status, duration_ms AS durationMs, tool_name AS toolName, error_code AS errorCode, payload_json AS payloadJson
mapper.select: SELECT event_type AS eventType, tool_name AS toolName, duration_ms AS durationMs FROM agent_trace_event WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT seq, event_type AS eventType, call_id AS callId, payload_json AS payloadJson FROM agent_trace_event WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND event_type IN ('plan/draft', 'plan/validate', 'plan/revise') ORDER BY seq ASC
